title: grafana-flamegraph package: control flow and core data model
answers: Where does control flow start in @grafana/flamegraph?
How does a DataFrame become the flame graph/top table/call tree views?
What is FlameGraphDataContainer and who consumes it?
Who calls into @grafana/flamegraph and how are feature flags passed in?
body:
Public API is `packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/index.ts`: exports `FlameGraph` (= `FlameGraphContainer`) plus `checkFields`/`getMessageCheckFieldsResult` (hosts must validate the DataFrame before rendering). Consumers: `public/app/plugins/panel/flamegraph/FlameGraphPanel.tsx` (dashboard panel, reads feature flags itself and passes plain booleans in), Explore's `FlameGraphExploreContainer.tsx`, trace view's `SpanFlameGraph.tsx`.

Flow: `FlameGraphContainer.tsx:FlameGraphContainer` builds a `FlameGraphDataContainer` from the `data` prop, owns view-mode/pane-selection + cross-pane state (search, focus, shared sandwich symbol), renders `FlameGraphHeader` + one/two `FlameGraphPane`. `FlameGraphPane.tsx:FlameGraphPane` owns per-pane state (focus, zoom range, text align, local sandwich item, `CollapsedMap`) and `switch`es on `paneView` to render `FlameGraphTopTableContainer` (TopTable/), `FlameGraph`→`FlameGraphCanvas`→`useFlameRender` (FlameGraph/rendering.ts), or `FlameGraphCallTreeContainer` (CallTree/). Interactions bubble up via callback props (`onTableSymbolClick`, `onViewSelected`, etc.) for host telemetry; `getExtraContextMenuButtons` lets hosts inject context-menu items.

Core model: `dataTransform.ts:FlameGraphDataContainer` lazily converts the flat nested-set DataFrame into `LevelItem[][]` via `nestedSetToLevels`, building a children/parents-linked tree, a `uniqueLabelsMap` (search), and a `CollapsedMap`. Sandwich view reshapes this tree via `treeTransforms.ts: mergeSubtrees`/`mergeParentSubtrees`.

Package reads no feature flags/config itself (used standalone by Pyroscope too) — flags are read by the host and passed in as booleans (see `FlameGraphPanel.tsx`).

search: The grafana-flamegraph package architecture and data flow: FlameGraphContainer (public via index.ts) orchestrates pane selection and renders FlameGraphPane(s); data transforms lazily via FlameGraphDataContainer from nested-set DataFrame to tree structure with search/collapse maps; interactions bubble up through callback props (onTableSymbolClick, onViewSelected). The package doesn't read feature flags itself—hosts (FlameGraphPanel.tsx, FlameGraphExploreContainer.tsx, SpanFlameGraph.tsx) must validate the input DataFrame via checkFields/getMessageCheckFieldsResult and pass flags as plain booleans. Key entry points: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/index.ts (public API), FlameGraphDataContainer (dataTransform.ts), mergeParentSubtrees (treeTransforms.ts), useFlameRender (rendering.ts). Use this guidance when integrating flamegraph into dashboards/Explore/traces, extending context-menu buttons via getExtraContextMenuButtons, or understanding per-pane state (focus, zoom, search) and cross-pane state (sandwich selection).
